response.sql:
WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(sm.facetfaces AS REAL)) as overall_baseline
  FROM scanmesh sm
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL
),
site_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    sm.zoneref,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(CAST(sm.facetfaces AS REAL)) as site_avg
  FROM scanmesh sm
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL AND s.entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sm.zoneref, s.entrystat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    entrystat,
    AVG(site_avg) as status_avg
  FROM site_averages
  GROUP BY entrystat
),
filtered_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.zoneref,
    sa.site_avg,
    sta.status_avg,
    b.overall_baseline
  FROM site_averages sa
  INNER JOIN status_averages sta ON sa.entrystat = sta.entrystat
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE sa.site_avg > sta.status_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(site_avg) as avg_faces,
  AVG(site_avg - overall_baseline) as avg_exceeds_baseline,
  AVG(site_avg - status_avg) as avg_exceeds_status
FROM filtered_sites

assumptions.assumption: Baseline includes all scanmesh records joined with sites (regardless of whether entry status is recorded), matching via zoneref = zoneregistry foreign key relationship
"Simple average of its sites' averages" means arithmetic mean of per-site averages with equal weight per site, not weighted by mesh record count
Null facetfaces values are excluded from all aggregations (standard SQL AVG behavior)
